## Original Source
```javascript
export default function (str) {
  const pattern = [
    '[\\u001B\\u009B][[\\]()#;?]*(?:(?:(?:[a-zA-Z\\d]*(?:;[a-zA-Z\\d]*)*)?\\u0007)',
    '(?:(?:\\d{1,4}(?:;\\d{0,4})*)?[\\dA-PRZcf-ntqry=><~]))',
  ].join('|');

  const RGX = new RegExp(pattern, 'g');
  return typeof str === 'string' ? str.replace(RGX, '') : str;
}

```
